Team —

Reviewed the SOW and the risk assessment. High level legal/security guidance below:

1) Audit rights: we can accept a single annual on-site audit, limited to the controls and logs we produce. Clause must specify that Redwood will provide redacted logs and a pre-agreed questionnaire. No unrestricted on-site access to systems or raw customer content. We should refuse any clause that allows the customer to interrogate production hosts directly.

2) Support access: allow timeboxed, escorted sessions for provisioning and troubleshooting (max 4 hours per event), with 48-hour notice except for agreed-on-call emergency windows. All sessions must be recorded and endpoint activity logged. No customer-managed shell access.

3) KMS/keys: we support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) but need to document the key rotation and escrow responsibilities.

4) Pricing guardrail: include a written carveout in the contract that any additional concessions given during the term must be renegotiated at renewal.

I've attached a short redline summary (redline_summary.pdf) showing the recommended contract language. If leadership wants a narrower surface for audits (e.g., questionnaire-only + once-every-24-months), flag that now — I can prepare alternate wording.

Laura
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
